title: CAP 003s Law Revision Act

LAW REVISION ACT
CHAPTER 3
REVISED EDITION 2020
SHOWING THE SUBSIDIARY LAWS AS AT
31ST DECEMBER, 2020

(REVISED EDITION 2011) ACT PROCLAMATION
A PROCLAMATION
Appointing a day for which all the Laws enacted prior to
that date are to be included in the Substantive Laws of
Belize, Revised Edition 2011.
By His excellency, Sir Colville N. Young.
G.C.M.G, M.B.E. Ph.D., J.P (S)
Governor-General
(Gazetted 29th August, 2015)
WHEREAS, Section 3(2) of the Law Revision Act, Chapter 3
of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2000-2003,
provides that the Commissioner shall prepare and publish the
revised edition of the Laws of Belize prior to such day as the
Governor-General shall appoint;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, COLVILLE N. YOUNG,
Governor-General of Belize, in exercise of the power vested in
me by the Law Revision Act, do hereby appoint and proclaim
as follows–
Citation. 1. This Proclamation may be cited as the–
LAW REVISION (SUBSTANTIVE LAWS OF
BELIZE) (REVISED EDITION 2011)
PROCLAMATION.
Appointment of 2. The 1st day of January, 2012 is hereby appointed as the day
day.
for which all the Laws enacted prior to that date are to be
included in the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2011.

Government of Belize
